question: Which of the following Amendments came into effect from 1 November 2025, giving depositors the flexibility to make nominations in banks?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banking Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Banking Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025** is a landmark piece of legislation aimed at strengthening **governance** in the Indian banking sector and enhancing **depositor protection**.
 
• One of the most significant changes introduced by this Act, effective from **1 November 2025**, is the increased flexibility in **nominations** for bank deposits and locker facilities.
 
• Under the new provisions, depositors are now permitted to have up to **four nominees** for their accounts, whereas the previous limit was restricted to only **one nominee**. ***Hence, the statement regarding nomination flexibility is correct.***
